name: plausible-ba
description: Methodology-grade business architecture for Claude. Five slash commands — /opmodel-context, /plausibleba, /capability-map, /concept-model, /value-stream — that build a sourced Context Document before discovery, then elicit, validate and visualise a Capability Map, a Concept Model and a Value Stream from any business description, each with validation checkpoints and XLSX + JSON exports, plus the shared BA taxonomy standard they all follow.
